duplicates.rule: Zero-lag raw comparison of every subject pair. identical = every non-constant named channel is sample-for-sample equal. near_duplicate = median Pearson r over non-constant named channels >= threshold. Independent recordings from different people are not expected to exceed |r| ~0.5; 0.99 is a signal-only threshold fixed before any outcome is read.
duplicates.exclusion_decision_record: User decision 2026-11-06 (Step 1): exclude both sub-04 and sub-05 from all v3 analyses. Near-identical pairs sub-11/15 and sub-47/49 are kept as shared split groups (StratifiedGroupKFold).

exclusion_options.exclude_both_identical: Exclude both members of every identical pair from all v3 analyses (correct label unknowable).
exclusion_options.keep_both_grouped: Keep both, as one split group.

events.match_rule: Each marker imagery onset is matched one-to-one (closest pairs first) to a sidecar imagery onset within +-2000 samples (half the 8 s trial period); left/right comes from the matched sidecar trial. A trial is usable for Step 2 when it is matched and has full-length imagery. Step 2 epochs from marker_onset, not the sidecar.
events.rule: Marker events are every sample where the marker code changes to a non-zero value (so a merged [1,2] pulse yields an instruction and an imagery event). Imagery trial k = k-th code-2 event; its length = samples to the next code-3 event (or recording end). Sidecar agreement: every trial |marker - sidecar| <= 25 samples (50 ms, 1.25% of a 4 s epoch). The original pre-set 10-sample (20 ms) tolerance is still reported; it was widened after seeing that typical lags are 2-19 samples, a label-independent hardware/software latency. Short trial: imagery length < 2000 - 10 samples. Marker codes carry trial phase only, not left/right: left/right is taken from the shared sidecar by trial index and cannot be verified per subject.

lesion.location_side_rule: Split stroke_location on commas only ('and' joins parts of one described region, e.g. 'Right ... lobe and insula'; the first run split on 'and' wrongly made sub-22 unclear and was corrected before any outcome was read). Each component's side is the side word it contains. location_side = left or right only if every component has that same side; 'bilateral' if any component is bilateral; 'mixed' if components disagree; 'unclear' if any component has no side word.
lesion.site_class_rule: cortical_involving if any component matches a cortical keyword; else subcortical_supratentorial if any matches a subcortical keyword; else infratentorial if any matches an infratentorial keyword; else unclear. has_infratentorial flags any infratentorial component.
lesion.final_side_rule: lesion_side_paralysis = contralateral of ParalysisSide (participants.json defines it as limb paralysis side). lesion_side_final = lesion_side_paralysis only if location_side equals it; otherwise 'uncertain' (excluded from lesion-aligned analyses only).
